name: SKYL_CLUTTER
meaning: Clutter. Object with this layer will float on water surface.

name: SKYL_BIPED
meaning: Biped. Seems to apply to all creatures/NPCs

name: SKYL_GROUND
meaning: Ground. It seems that produces no sound when collide.

name: BUILT_WITHOUT_CHUNK_SUBDIVISION
meaning: Not organized in chunks for PC. (Default)

name: FMT_RGB
meaning: 24-bit RGB. 8 bits per red, blue, and green component.

name: FMT_RGBA
meaning: 32-bit RGB with alpha. 8 bits per red, blue, green, and alpha component.

name: FMT_RGB24NONINT
meaning: (Deprecated) 24-bit noninterleaved texture, an old PS2 format.

name: FMT_BUMPLUMA
meaning: Uncompressed dU/dV gradient bump map with luma channel representing shininess.

name: FMT_RENDERSPEC
meaning: Generic descriptor for any renderer-specific format not described by other formats.

name: FMT_1CH
meaning: Generic descriptor for formats with 1 component.

name: FMT_2CH
meaning: Generic descriptor for formats with 2 components.

name: FMT_3CH
meaning: Generic descriptor for formats with 3 components.

name: FMT_4CH
meaning: Generic descriptor for formats with 4 components.

name: FMT_DEPTH_STENCIL
meaning: Indicates the NiPixelFormat is meant to be used on a depth/stencil surface.

name: LAY_HIGH_COLOR_16
meaning: Texture is in 16-bit high color format.

name: LAY_TRUE_COLOR_32
meaning: Texture is in 32-bit true color format.

name: LAY_BUMPMAP
meaning: Texture is a grayscale bump map.

name: MIP_FMT_NO
meaning: Texture does not use mip maps.

name: CLAMP_S_WRAP_T
meaning: Clamp in the S(U) direction but wrap in the T(V) direction.

name: WRAP_S_CLAMP_T
meaning: Wrap in the S(U) direction but clamp in the T(V) direction.

name: FILTER_NEAREST
meaning: Nearest neighbor. Uses nearest texel with no mipmapping.

name: FILTER_BILERP
meaning: Bilinear. Linear interpolation with no mipmapping.

name: FILTER_TRILERP
meaning: Trilinear. Linear intepolation between 8 texels (4 nearest texels between 2 nearest mip levels).

name: FILTER_NEAREST_MIPNEAREST
meaning: Nearest texel on nearest mip level.

name: FILTER_NEAREST_MIPLERP
meaning: Linear interpolates nearest texel between two nearest mip levels.

name: FILTER_BILERP_MIPNEAREST
meaning: Linear interpolates on nearest mip level.

name: FILTER_ANISOTROPIC
meaning: Anisotropic filtering. One or many trilinear samples depending on anisotropy.

name: VERT_MODE_SRC_IGNORE
meaning: Emissive, ambient, and diffuse colors are all specified by the NiMaterialProperty.

name: VERT_MODE_SRC_EMISSIVE
meaning: Emissive colors are specified by the source vertex colors. Ambient+Diffuse are specified by the NiMaterialProperty.

name: VERT_MODE_SRC_AMB_DIF
meaning: Ambient+Diffuse colors are specified by the source vertex colors. Emissive is specified by the NiMaterialProperty. (Default)

name: ALWAYS_FACE_CAMERA
meaning: Align billboard and camera forward vector. Minimized rotation.

name: ROTATE_ABOUT_UP
meaning: Align billboard and camera forward vector while allowing rotation around the up axis.

name: RIGID_FACE_CAMERA
meaning: Align billboard and camera forward vector. Non-minimized rotation.

name: ALWAYS_FACE_CENTER
meaning: Billboard forward vector always faces camera ceneter. Minimized rotation.

name: RIGID_FACE_CENTER
meaning: Billboard forward vector always faces camera ceneter. Non-minimized rotation.

name: BSROTATE_ABOUT_UP
meaning: The billboard will only rotate around its local Z axis (it always stays in its local X-Y plane).

name: ROTATE_ABOUT_UP2
meaning: The billboard will only rotate around the up axis (same as ROTATE_ABOUT_UP?).

name: TEST_NEVER
meaning: Always false. Ref value is ignored.

name: ACTION_KEEP
meaning: Keep the current value in the stencil buffer.

name: ACTION_ZERO
meaning: Write zero to the stencil buffer.

name: ACTION_REPLACE
meaning: Write the reference value to the stencil buffer.

name: ACTION_INCREMENT
meaning: Increment the value in the stencil buffer.

name: ACTION_DECREMENT
meaning: Decrement the value in the stencil buffer.

name: ACTION_INVERT
meaning: Bitwise invert the value in the stencil buffer.

name: DRAW_CCW_OR_BOTH
meaning: Application default, chooses between DRAW_CCW or DRAW_BOTH.

name: DRAW_CCW
meaning: Draw only the triangles whose vertices are ordered CCW with respect to the viewer. (Standard behavior)

name: DRAW_CW
meaning: Draw only the triangles whose vertices are ordered CW with respect to the viewer. (Effectively flips faces)

name: DRAW_BOTH
meaning: Draw all triangles, regardless of orientation. (Effectively force double-sided)

name: TEST_NEVER
meaning: Always false. Ref value is ignored.

name: MO_SYS_DYNAMIC
meaning: A fully-simulated, movable rigid body. At construction time the engine checks the input inertia and selects MO_SYS_SPHERE_INERTIA or MO_SYS_BOX_INERTIA as appropriate.

name: MO_SYS_SPHERE_INERTIA
meaning: Simulation is performed using a sphere inertia tensor.

name: MO_SYS_SPHERE_STABILIZED
meaning: This is the same as MO_SYS_SPHERE_INERTIA, except that simulation of the rigid body is "softened".

name: MO_SYS_BOX_INERTIA
meaning: Simulation is performed using a box inertia tensor.

name: MO_SYS_BOX_STABILIZED
meaning: This is the same as MO_SYS_BOX_INERTIA, except that simulation of the rigid body is "softened".

name: MO_SYS_KEYFRAMED
meaning: Simulation is not performed as a normal rigid body. The keyframed rigid body has an infinite mass when viewed by the rest of the system. (used for creatures)

name: MO_SYS_FIXED
meaning: This motion type is used for the static elements of a game scene, e.g. the landscape. Faster than MO_SYS_KEYFRAMED at velocity 0. (used for weapons)

name: MO_SYS_THIN_BOX
meaning: A box inertia motion which is optimized for thin boxes and has less stability problems

name: MO_SYS_CHARACTER
meaning: A specialized motion used for character controllers

name: DEACTIVATOR_NEVER
meaning: This will force the rigid body to never deactivate.

name: DEACTIVATOR_SPATIAL
meaning: Tells Havok to use a spatial deactivation scheme. This makes use of high and low frequencies of positional motion to determine when deactivation should occur.

name: SOLVER_DEACTIVATION_LOW
meaning: Very conservative deactivation, typically no visible artifacts.

name: SOLVER_DEACTIVATION_MEDIUM
meaning: Normal deactivation, no serious visible artifacts in most cases.

name: MO_QUAL_INVALID
meaning: Automatically assigned to MO_QUAL_FIXED, MO_QUAL_KEYFRAMED or MO_QUAL_DEBRIS

name: MO_QUAL_DEBRIS
meaning: Low importance bodies adding visual detail.

name: MO_QUAL_MOVING
meaning: Moving bodies which should not penetrate or leave the world, but can.

name: MO_QUAL_CRITICAL
meaning: Gameplay critical bodies which cannot penetrate or leave the world under any circumstance.

name: MO_QUAL_CHARACTER
meaning: For use with rigid body character controllers.

name: MO_QUAL_KEYFRAMED_REPORT
meaning: Moving bodies with infinite mass which should report contact points and TOI collisions against all other bodies.

name: ENDIAN_BIG
meaning: The numbers are stored in big endian format, such as those used by PowerPC Mac processors.

name: ENDIAN_LITTLE
meaning: The numbers are stored in little endian format, such as those used by Intel and AMD x86 processors.

name: PROPAGATE_ON_SUCCESS
meaning: Propagation only occurs as a result of a successful collision.

name: PROPAGATE_ON_FAILURE
meaning: (Deprecated) Propagation only occurs as a result of a failed collision.

name: PROPAGATE_ALWAYS
meaning: Propagation always occurs regardless of collision result.

name: PROPAGATE_NEVER
meaning: Propagation never occurs regardless of collision result.

name: PROPAGATE_UNKNOWN_6
meaning: Propagation mode found in Civ IV Chariot_Celtic.

name: NOTEST
meaning: Indicates that no collision test should be made.

name: RESPONSE_REPORTING
meaning: No collision resolution is performed but listeners are called

name: RESPONSE_NONE
meaning: Do nothing, ignore all the results.

name: Parallax Occ
meaning: Enables Height(TS4), Max Passes, Scale. Unimplemented.

name: MultiLayer Parallax
meaning: Enables EnvMap Mask(TS6), Layer(TS7), Parallax Layer Thickness, Parallax Refraction Scale, Parallax Inner Layer U Scale, Parallax Inner Layer V Scale, EnvMap Scale

name: LOD Objects HD
meaning: NIF.BSLightingShaderProperty.ShaderType enum value 15: LOD Objects HD

name: Eye Envmap
meaning: Enables EnvMap Mask(TS6), Eye EnvMap Scale

name: LOD Landscape Noise
meaning: NIF.BSLightingShaderProperty.ShaderType enum value 18: LOD Landscape Noise

name: Multitexture Landscape LOD Blend
meaning: NIF.BSLightingShaderProperty.ShaderType enum value 19: Multitexture Landscape LOD Blend

name: PRIORITY_PSI
meaning: Constraint is only solved at regular physics time steps.

name: PRIORITY_TOI
meaning: Constraint is also solved at time of impact events.

name: Compressed
meaning: Default compression enabled for archive entries (zlib for v104, LZ4 for v105)

name: RetainDirectoryNames
meaning: Retain directory names in runtime lookup

name: RetainFileNames
meaning: Retain file names in runtime lookup

name: RetainFileNameOffsets
meaning: Retain file name offsets in runtime lookup

name: RetainStringsDuringStartup
meaning: Retain archive string tables during startup

name: EmbedFileNames
meaning: Each compressed/stored file record is prefixed with its length-prefixed filename

name: CompressionToggle
meaning: Bit 30 (0x40000000) toggles compression relative to archive Compressed flag

name: Global
meaning: Papyrus function is Global (static, no self parameter)

name: Native
meaning: Papyrus function is Native (engine-implemented, no bytecode)

name: Readable
meaning: Papyrus property has a get accessor or auto-var read

name: Writable
meaning: Papyrus property has a set accessor or auto-var write

name: AutoVar
meaning: Papyrus property is backed by an automatic member variable

name: PingPong
meaning: Play clip forward and backward alternatingly

name: unknown
meaning: Byte flags field on hkbClipGenerator (offset 0x73, bits undocumented in CommonLibSSE-NG)

name: Additive
meaning: Additive animation binding relative to base pose

name: enabled
meaning: State machine state is enabled for transitions

name: FLAG_SILENT
meaning: Clip generators do not raise this behavior event

name: FLAG_SYNC_POINT
meaning: Behavior event acts as an animation sync point

name: FLAG_NOT_VARIABLE
meaning: Property cannot be bound to a behavior variable

name: FLAG_HIDDEN
meaning: Property hidden in Havok Animation Tool UI

name: FLAG_OUTPUT
meaning: Property is an output rather than input

name: FLAG_NOT_CHARACTER_PROPERTY
meaning: Property cannot be bound to a character property

name: StaticX
meaning: Translation/scale X (or quat) component is static

name: SplineX
meaning: Translation/scale X (or quat) component is spline-compressed
